name: repair-demo
description: Slightly larger dataset used to smoke-test the diagnosis/repair loop against a deliberately weak config.

cases.question: How long do we retain customer support tickets?

documents.title: Data Retention Schedule
documents.text: Support ticket records, including attachments and chat transcripts, are kept for 18 months after the ticket is closed, after which they are purged from primary storage.

documents.title: Vacation Policy
documents.text: Employees accrue fifteen days of paid vacation per year, increasing to twenty days after five years of tenure.

documents.title: Office Wifi Setup
documents.text: Connect to the guest network using the password posted in the break room. IT rotates the password monthly.

documents.title: Expense Reimbursement
documents.text: Submit expense reports within 60 days of the purchase date for reimbursement via the finance portal.

documents.title: Parking Policy
documents.text: Reserved parking spots are assigned by seniority and reviewed annually by facilities.

documents.title: Meeting Room Booking
documents.text: Book conference rooms through the calendar system at least 30 minutes in advance for meetings over four people.

cases.reference_answer: Customer support ticket records are retained for 18 months after closure before being purged.

cases.question: What is our policy on keeping past support requests before we get rid of them?

documents.title: Data Retention Schedule
documents.text: Ticket records, including attachments and chat transcripts, remain in the archive for eighteen months following closure, after which they are permanently purged from primary storage.

documents.title: Support Request Escalation
documents.text: Support requests that remain unresolved for more than 48 hours before being escalated get routed to a senior agent for follow-up.

documents.title: Support Request Intake Form
documents.text: New support requests must include an account ID, a description of the issue, and the urgency level before being submitted to the queue.

documents.title: Support Request Prioritization
documents.text: Support requests are prioritized by severity; before assignment, a triage agent tags each request with a priority level.

cases.reference_answer: Ticket records remain in the archive for eighteen months after closure before being permanently purged.
